name: Rough Terrain Crane
instructions: omr/instructions/8270-1-1.pdf and 8270-1-2.pdf (book 1: functions on page 2, chassis steps 1-15, crane steps 1-7; book 2: crane steps 8-21); books 3 and 4 build the alternate model

functions.does: The crane's upper works turn round on the chassis, carrying the boom with them: they sit on a 36-tooth gear that turns on a pin in the chassis's middle.
functions.source: book: 1 page 2 (inset, arrows round the top); book 2 step 19 (the 36-tooth gear and pins)

functions.does: The gear knob at the back raises and lowers the boom: its long axle turns a worm, which turns an 8-tooth gear on a cross axle, whose two grey arms lift the boom about its pivot at the back upright.
functions.source: book: 1 page 2 (curved arrow on the boom); book 1 crane step 5 (worm axle), book 2 steps 8-9 (8-tooth gear and lifting arms, boom pivot) and 12 (knob, arrow)

functions.does: The gear knob on the end of the winch drum's axle, high on the upper works' side, winds the winch, raising or lowering the hook: the string runs from the drum along the boom and over its tip.
functions.source: book: 1 page 2 (up and down arrow at the hook); book 2 steps 10 (drum, knob and string), 17-18 (string over the boom tip, hook)

functions.does: The black inner boom slides in and out of the yellow outer boom by hand, carrying the pulley at its tip.
functions.source: inferred: book 2 step 16 slides a plain 15-long beam into the crane arm's channel, and book 1 page 2 shows the boom at two lengths; not sure it is meant to slide

functions.does: The two pairs of black outrigger legs, one at each end of the chassis, fold down to stand the crane on, each pair turning together on its own axle.
functions.source: book: 1 page 2 (inset, arrows at the ends of the chassis); book 1 chassis step 12 (arrows)

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely on their pins; there's no steering.
An 8-tooth gear on a friction pin meshes with the 8-tooth gear on the winch drum's axle, a brake that holds the hook where it is left.
functions.source: inferred: book 2 steps 12-13 add the two 8-tooth gears beside the drum; what they are for is a guess
functions.skip: a friction brake only resists gravity; the winch works both ways without it

functions.does: The hook hangs straight down beneath the boom tip, with the red beam hooked on it, as the crane slews and the boom rises.
functions.note: hangs under gravity: the hook p57 30395 and the load p101 3702
